author: dreambig5
body:
Check for updates first (the game & your OS)! Force the app to close and try again. 

Restart your phone.

If none of those work, uninstall the game, and reinstall it.

Last case scenario, note down your OS version, and the version of the game that is installed & brief explanation of the problem & roughly when it started & share that in discord (I think there's a section for reporting bugs). 

P.S. I am NOT a dev for this game, but this is usually how I'd deal with this.

author: huehahahue
body: Phones can be very tricky in uptime - just a simple restart can make wonders (or turn it off completely and start again) .
